newsitem.title: USA: Kaynar wins nearly 8 pct premium after IPO.
newsitem.headline: Kaynar wins nearly 8 pct premium after IPO.

text.p: Shares of Kaynar Technologies Inc managed a gain of nearly eight percent on their first day of trading after the company's initial public offering.
Kaynar makes specialty fasteners and related components mostly used for the production of commercial aircraft and defense products.
Shares rose 1-1/8, or 7.75 percent, to 15-5/8 from their pricing at $14.50.

It was a solid gain in what has been a generally weak market and one of the few IPOs to manage gains without pricing below its estimated pricing range. The company had estimated that the two million shares to be offered would price at between $14 and $16 each.
Lehman Brothers was the lead underwriter of the offering.
